reader_contract.figure_question: Can a post-input Layer-2 successor continue to condition the following input across history depth, carry its influence through a second transition, and recur in an unmanipulated sequence?
reader_contract.terminal_inference: Under the tested single-transplant protocol, the post-B Layer-2 successor redirected the next input and the successor formed from it at K=1, 5 and 10, and the same influence remained detectable through a following transition at K=5. In a separate progressive protocol, input-driven change exceeded equal-time passive continuation across transitions and deeper history altered behavioral Rescue and Loss.
forbidden_inferences: donor transfer establishes necessity, complete mediation, or uniqueness
K=1, K=5 and K=10 were compared by a prespecified trend test
the second-transition experiment used a second transplant
transition number is equivalent to history depth K
Rescue and Loss share one opportunity denominator
the schematic depicts one continuously tracked state instance across every protocol

semantic_units.a: define the donor-to-receiver successor transfer, next-input and following-input state-transition process
semantic_units.b: show single-transplant transfer across history depths in input response and successor state
semantic_units.c: show transfer remains detectable through the second transition at K=5
semantic_units.d: show input-driven change persists across unmanipulated transition numbers
semantic_units.e: show deeper history changes Rescue and Loss
